name: AL (light-chain) amyloidosis
theme: the two-currency disease · the anti-fibril frontier

meta.title: AL amyloidosis in silico decision trainer
meta.population: Adults with systemic AL amyloidosis - THE TWO-CURRENCY DISEASE: a small plasma-cell clone (the myeloma trainer's neighbor) whose misfolded light chains destroy organs, so every decision and every checkpoint runs on TWO currencies at once - the CLONE'S response (hematologic, dFLC-based, arrives in weeks) and the ORGANS' response (cardiac/renal, lags months to years) - and survival rides the clone's depth while quality of life rides the organs' recovery. Rare (~10-14 per million person-years - and NOT SEER-TRACKED: the epidemiology itself is claims-based, verified receipt), with exactly ONE approved therapy. The wrong-amyloid trap guards the door: ATTR amyloidosis is a different disease with different drugs (tafamidis is NOT for AL), and mass-spectrometry typing is the artifact that prevents treating the wrong one.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the two-currency disease. THE ONLY APPROVED THERAPY: ANDROMEDA (verified, NEJM 2021) - daratumumab added to CyBorD tripled hematologic CR (53.3% vs 18.1%), doubled organ responses, won accelerated approval (2021 - still the only AL approval as of this sweep), and its FINAL OS ANALYSIS read out POSITIVE (Blood 2026 - cited by DOI, the PMID resisted matching: flagged; ~76% five-year OS on the dara arm at snippet grade). THE TWICE-FAILED POST-HOC is the frontier's headline: birtamimab's VITAL failed, a post-hoc stage-IV signal launched AFFIRM-AL as the co…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: Mayo cardiac-biomarker staging - 2004 (NT-proBNP/troponin: median OS 26.4/10.5/3.5 months by stage, verified - with the sweep catching a summarizer UNIT ERROR that had rendered these as years) and 2012 revised (adding dFLC: stages I-IV, median OS 94.1/40.3/14/5.8 months, verified); stage IIIb (NT-proBNP > 8,500) as the excluded-from-everything population; amyloid TYPING by laser-microdissection mass spectrometry (Vrana, verified - IHC is insufficient); t(11;14) in ~50% (the relapse door's biomarker)
meta.response: THE TWO CURRENCIES: hematologic response by dFLC criteria (Palladini 2012, verified - 816-patient derivation) and organ response by ISA consensus (Tours 2004, verified; graded cardiac update matched) - read together, never conflated: a clone in remission with organs still failing and organs recovering under a stirring clone are different situations demanding different moves

Patient.label: Performance status (ECOG)
Patient.help: In AL the performance score is often the ORGANS speaking - and it can improve dramatically as the clone falls and the organs heal, on organ time.

Clone biology.label: t(11;14) FISH

Newly diagnosed.name: Daratumumab-CyBorD (ANDROMEDA - the only approved road)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the approved standard (accelerated 2021; OS receipt positive at DOI-cited grade)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized - hemCR and organ responses verified; final OS positive (DOI-cited, PMID flagged)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: CyBorD's neuropathy-and-steroid ledger + daratumumab's infusion/infection ledger - in organ-fragile patients, dose craft matters more than anywhere
Newly diagnosed.patient: The one proven, approved treatment: an antibody plus a three-drug backbone, aimed at the small marrow clone making the harmful protein - it triples deep responses and, in the final analysis, extended life.

Newly diagnosed.name: ASCT for the eligible minority (the honestly-historied question)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: an option for the selected eligible minority (EHA-ISA matched) - the randomized history said, the modern re-ask open
Newly diagnosed.evidence: selected-series grade (verified series) with a NEGATIVE randomized legacy (Jaccard verified) - the honest composite, flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: high-dose melphalan's full ledger - in organ-involved patients, center experience is the safety variable
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the fit minority: a stem-cell transplant - with an honest history (the one randomized trial, years ago, favored the tablets) and a modern trial now asking whether transplant adds anything to today's antibody-based standard.

Newly diagnosed.name: Stage IIIb (the excluded population - its own honesty)

Newly diagnosed.toxicity: everything is harder in a IIIb heart - attenuated dosing and hospital-level support are the craft
Newly diagnosed.patient: When the heart is most severely strained: treatment starts within days, gently dosed and closely watched - with honesty that the big trial excluded exactly this situation, and that a dedicated study now exists for it.

THE ANTI-FIBRIL FRONTIER, verified to the month: BIRTAMIMAB DEAD - AFFIRM-AL (NCT04973137, Mayo stage IV, under SPA) MISSED primary (ACM HR 0.915, p=0.768) and both secondaries; development discontinued 2025-05 incl. OLE; ~63% workforce cut - THE TWICE-FAILED POST-HOC (VITAL missed 2018 -> post-hoc stage-IV signal HR 0.413 -> confirmatory AFFIRM-AL -> signal did NOT replicate). ANSELAMIMAB (CAEL-101): CARES twins (NCT04512235/NCT04504825) missed overall primary (2025-07) with PRESPECIFIED KAPPA-subgroup survival + CVH benefit (ASCO 2026 + JCO 2026 per trials-sweep sources; the anchors sweep could not verify the subgroup definition - both statuses carried); regulatory discussions ongoing, NO filing/approval confirmed; no successor trial recruiting. Phase 1a/b receipt PMID 34521113 matched. THE FRONTIER IS CLOSED TO NEW AL PATIENTS as of 2026-08-19

THE INVERTED-CARDIOLOGY LESSON (consensus grade, said): beta-blockers/ACEi/ARBs often harmful in amyloid's restrictive, preload-and-rate-dependent physiology; verapamil/diltiazem and digoxin classically cautioned (fibril binding); loop diuretics +/- spironolactone the backbone; AF thrombus-prone - low anticoagulation threshold; ICD benefit unproven. Supported by matched review (PMID 35414852, title-matched) - consensus, not RCT, grade | PMID 35414852 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
